name: rombo
description: Editor di diagrammi entità-relazione (notazione Chen), per Windows, Linux e macOS
author: Alessio Ferrari <alessioferrari374@gmail.com>

scripts.dist:light: npm run web:build:light && npm run verify:light && electron-builder -c electron-builder.light.yml
scripts.dist:linux:light: npm run web:build:light && npm run verify:light && electron-builder -c electron-builder.light.yml --linux
scripts.dist:win:light: npm run web:build:light && npm run verify:light && electron-builder -c electron-builder.light.yml --win
scripts.dist:mac:light: npm run web:build:light && npm run verify:light && electron-builder -c electron-builder.light.yml --mac
